entities.summary: Barcelos, Vila Boa e Vila Frescainha  is a civil parish in the municipality of Barcelos, Portugal. It was formed in 2013 by the merger of the former parishes Barcelos, Vila Boa, Vila Frescainha and Vila Frescainha. The population in 2011 was 11,108, in an area of 9.30 km².
